## Chimera v1.1.24 - ESP recovery

Fixes the two ways the overlay could stop drawing while the core still reported a healthy attach.

### The root went stale

`get_data_model()` trusted a cached pointer whenever its class read `DataModel`. The client publishes a DataModel before the game loads and then replaces it - the old one keeps the class name and reports zero children, so every reader downstream walked an empty tree. The cache now requires children, and a stale root is resolved again instead of being handed out.

### The offsets table churned

`offsets.ini` was rewritten on every theo sync even when no value had moved - every five minutes in steady state, and every 20-60 s while validation was failing. The overlay watched the file's mtime, so each rewrite detached the Roblox handle, dropped the resolved root and hid the window. Saves now compare content, and the overlay hashes the file instead of watching the mtime.

### Smaller

- the 6 s slot recovery sweep no longer runs on the render thread
- `overlay.log` gets `DataModel resolved at 0x...`, one line per attach

### Checks

Core, overlay and shell built from the same tree. Overlay resolves in ~0.2 s against a live client, and a forced offsets sync leaves both the file and the overlay untouched.
